bio: The Roslin Beach Hotel is a four AA silver star hotel and spa located in Southend-on-Sea.    Few restaurants can boast such an unrivalled view as the Roslin Beach Hotel; a charming boutique hotel sitting on the coast overlooking Thorpe Bay beach. You can enjoy the classic English delicacy of Afternoon Tea whilst taking in the beautiful seaside scenery.    Afternoon Tea is served in one of the hotels’ Afternoon Tea rooms, both of which are bright and welcoming spaces with panoramic views of the Thames Estuary.  The Afternoon Tea is a traditional affair with dainty finger sandwiches, seasonal savouries, freshly baked scones, and an array of elegant cakes to satisfy your sweet tooth.  You can enjoy unlimited tea and coffee throughout your experience whether you choose the Traditional or Sparkling Afternoon Tea. If you opt for the choice of sparkling, you can indulge in a chilled glass of champagne to accompany your Afternoon Tea.
